info.structure_gel.place: • Padėkite tupiant, kad suaktyvintumėte plitimo efektą.
info.structure_gel.gunpowder: • Panaudokite paraką, kad sunaikinti visus sujungtus gelius.
info.structure_gel.default: • Platina gelį palei pagrindines kryptis, tik pakeičiant orą.
info.structure_gel.photosensitive: • Tik platina gelį pozicijose, kur jis neatidengtas dangui. Puikiai tinka kambariams su atidarytoms sienoms.
info.structure_gel.diagonal_spread: • Platina save palei pagrindines ir įstrižaines kryptis. Naudinga, kai reikia apeiti vijoklius ir kitokius keistus kampus.
info.structure_gel.dynamic_spread_dist: • Platina gelį su nustatytu atstumu atsižvelgiant į kiek jūs jų laikote. Limitas yra 50.
info.structure_gel.axis_spread: • Platina gelį plokščioje platumoje remiantis kaip jis buvo padėtas.
info.structure_gel.unknown_behavior: • Šio bloko elgesys yra neapibrėžtas. Įsitikinkite, kad jūs naudojate arba esate prasitęsė nuo StructureGelBlock kode.
item.structure_gel.building_tool.info.ho: • Press [%s] in the air to select a mode.n• For modes that require a selected block, you can right click with an item held in your mouse onto this stack to select that block.
item.structure_gel.building_tool.mode.de: • Wait... How'd you get here? Oh well, you're here now so I guess this isn't a secret anymore. While I have your attention, don't forget to stay hydrated!
• Removes the blocks in the selected area.nn• Press [%s] on a block to select the first corner.n• Press [%s] on another block to select the second corner.n• Press [%s] to clear the area.

• Fills the selected area with the block selected.nn• Press [%s] on a block to select what to fill with.n• Press [%s] on a block to select the first corner.n• Press [%s] on another block to select the second corner.n• Press [%s] to fill the area with the selected block.

• Clones the selected area to your location.nn• Press [%s] on a block to select the first corner.n• Press [%s] on another block to select the second corner.n• Press [%s] to clone the selected area to your location.

• Floods the y level against the side of the block clicked with the block selected.nn• Press [%s] on a block to select what to flood with.n• Press [%s] or [%s] on the side of a block that faces where you intend to flood.
• Detects a shape based on the side of the block clicked and continues it in the direction that was clicked.nn• Press [%s] or [%s] the side of a block to extend a shape.

• Moves the region selected in the direction you're looking.nn• Press [%s] on a block to select the first corner.n• Press [%s] on another block to select the second corner.n• Press [%s] to move the area in the direction you're looking.

• Places a line of blocks between the positions selected.nn• Press [%s] on a block to select what to fill with.n• Press [%s] on a block to select the first position.n• Press [%s] on another block to select the second position.n• Press [%s] to place the line using the selected block.
• Fills the blocks around where you click with the block selected.nn• Press [%s] on a block to select what to place.n• Press [%s] or [%s] to fill the blocks around where you click.
info.structure_gel.building_tool.undo.de: • Undoes the previous action performed with a %s.n• You may also press ctrl + z.
info.structure_gel.building_tool.redo.de: • Redoes a previously undone action performed with a %s.n• You may also press ctrl + y.
info.structure_gel.building_tool.select_: • Uses your current position as one of the positions for the current mode.n• If both positions are selected, this button clears the positions.
info.structure_gel.building_tool.selecte: • The block that will be placed if the current mode supports it.n• Current value: %s.
info.structure_gel.building_tool.propert: • Determines how many of the blocks will actually be placed.
• The radius of the area affected.
• When true, maintains the exact block state of the selected block. When false, the blocks placed will place according to how they would naturally place, if they can be palced.
• Determines what blocks should be replaced.
• Rotates what the currently selected tool mode will place by the amount selected.
• Mirrors what the currently selected tool mode will place along the axis selected.
• When true, removes the original region from the world.
• Changes how the fill function works, similar to how the fill command works.
• Determines the shape of the area to affect.
commands.structure_gel.clone.override: Overriding vanilla clone limit of %s blocks by cloning %s blocks. This may take some time
commands.structure_gel.fill.override: Overriding vanilla fill limit of %s blocks by filling %s blocks. This may take some time
You need access to commands to access items in this tab.
